build_classifier_layer: build a ClassifierLayer with type mlp to classify multimodal features into output classes
create_modal_combine_layer: create a ModalCombineLayer using MFH to fuse image features and question embeddings
build_mfh_module: build an MFH module with hidden sizes and pool size for multiple feature hierarchy fusion
create_attn_pool2d: create an AttnPool2d layer with multiheaded attention for 2D spatial feature pooling
build_branch_combine_layer: build a BranchCombineLayer to fuse CGA, CBN, and question features for three-branch prediction
